text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After having watched a scrimmage
together,
Mayano Top Gun and I head
back home, when...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Maya! Did you come to the race to
support
me?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yep! Nice hustle out there, Urara. ☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Today was super fun! I may have come in
dead
last, but I still got to run a lot. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Cool! You're so positive! I always sulk
when I
lose! ☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think racing is fun no matter what! I just
love
running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But... winning is really hard! How do you
do it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're always super fast—like a
jet!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think if I were as fast as you, I'd totally
win too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Good idea! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you practice with me, I'm sure you'll
win next
time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Maya & Trainer's Special
Lecture
Series! ☆ You'll be our one and
only student for
today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! Urara, reporting for duty!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not a second to waste! Let's get started!
First, a
question for Trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What does Urara need to win?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right! ☆ I'd expect nothing less of
my
trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: バテないようにスタミナをつけよう！
ライバルを追い抜かすコツを掴もう！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Now then, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply... you totally ran out of
fuel
mid-flight in your last race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I totally did! It was so fun, but I was
super beat!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you can improve your stamina, you
should be
able to run without tiring
yourself out. ☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Makes sense! You're so smart, Maya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Cool your jets for a sec! I'm your teacher
today,
so call me Miss Maya!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yes, Miss Maya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so Haru Urara's training with Miss Mayano Top Gun begins.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ☆ Are you reading my mind?! I
was
thinking the same thing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Urara, how do you usually run?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Usually? I just run with everything I've
got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... Is there anything you're
having
trouble with?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um, I just can't seem to get ahead! I
always think
that I'll smack into someone
and start panicking!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oho! I see!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's try this. Next time you run, only
look
straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Keep gazing ahead, and then when no
one's in
front of you...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's when you blast forward! ☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll give it a try! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you'll never guess what! I passed
someone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay, you did it! You passed someo—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Someone? Just one person?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'll just keep passing people one
by one
until I get first! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Keep that up and you'll definitely
make it to
first one day!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems helping out Haru Urara has
been a
positive experience for Mayano
Top Gun.
